item.title: Remote workers report the highest well-being in study of 7,700 employees
item.description:
📝 "People who are remote actually said more things that indicated they had more positive connections, even though they were remote," Johnson said. They found that employees with higher well-being were less likely to leave the organization. One explanation is that remote workers have greater control over their work setup and daily schedule, she said.
🔗 Read more: https://www.colorado.edu/today/2026/08/12/remote-workers-report-highest-well-being-study-7700-employees

item.title: Civic Hygiene – avoid building technologies that could be used by a police state (2013)
item.description:
📝 He concludes by saying: It's bad civic hygiene to build technologies that could someday be used to facilitate a police state. Should we have a national database of, say, religious beliefs. Civic hygiene isn't about saying we distrust our current government - it's about not trusting the next government.
🔗 Read more: https://shkspr.mobi/blog/2013/11/civic-hygiene/
